name: sol-pay-kit-agreement
description: Not published, and not a dependency of anything. This is the one place the @solana/kit range is written down: bin/build-rust --client copies it into pkg/package.json as an optional peerDependency, and bin/test-kit installs it so that kit.mjs can earn it. One string, declared once. See conformance/kit.mjs for what the agreement is and why nothing else checks it.
